description: The path sections of a domain's pages with their page counts, one level at a time. Pass a section to list the level below it. Changes nothing. Needs a token; a read-only API key is sufficient and recommended.

domain.description: The connected domain, as a hostname, e.g. example.com.

section.description: List the sections below this path, e.g. /br. Omit for the top level.

name: list_page_sections
title: List page sections
